title: Spatial Features v4
description: CARTO Spatial Features: location features with global coverage unified on common spatial supports (H3 resolution 8 hexagons of ~0.74 km², Quadgrid level 15 cells of ~1 km). Each cell carries population and full age/sex structure (WorldPop), points-of-interest counts by category (Overture Maps), elevation, an urbanity classification, monthly climate normals (WorldClim), nighttime lights (VIIRS), cell-tower density (OpenCellID) and CARTO's Human Activity Index. The public tier covers Spain, the United Kingdom and the United States; other countries are premium Data Observatory datasets.
